name: Magento
tagline: Magento (now Adobe Commerce) is an open-source ecommerce platform used by large retailers and B2B companies for highly customised online stores. Its AI-powered features — product recommendations, predictive search, and customer segment analysis — are built into the Adobe Sensei engine. Merchants with complex catalogue management needs and deep customisation requirements choose Magento over more constrained SaaS alternatives.
